# Behavioral-eval dependencies for abp (#3588916).
#
# NOT needed for the static path: `python3 evals/run-evals.py --static` and the
# CI `evals-static` job run on the standard library alone. Keep it that way.
#
# Needed for:
#   - behavioral runs that load YAML cases (run-evals.py --behavioral, compare.py)
#     -> PyYAML
#   - the native Inspect AI runner (evals/inspect/, run via `inspect eval`)
#     -> inspect-ai  (pulls ~40 transitive packages; behavioral-only on purpose)
#   - registering the abp_cli ModelAPI as an inspect_ai entry point, so
#     `inspect eval ... --model abp_cli/...` resolves the provider at CLI launch
#     -> the editable -e ./evals/inspect install below (see evals/inspect/pyproject.toml)
#
# Install into a venv (run from the repo root so the relative -e path resolves):
#   python3 -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate
#   pip install -r evals/requirements-behavioral.txt

pyyaml>=6.0
inspect-ai>=0.3.241
-e ./evals/inspect
